value.body: The Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) is a four-year dual degree — B.A. B.Ed., B.Sc. B.Ed. or B.Com. B.Ed. — that combines a subject degree with teacher training. Each programme prepares teachers for one school stage: foundational, preparatory, middle or secondary. It was introduced by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) in 2023-24 under NEP 2020.

items.label: Course length
items.note: 8 semesters; one programme gives both degrees

items.label: Students in integrated B.Ed degrees
items.note: All modes; B.A., B.Sc. and B.Com. B.Ed. combined. Includes older integrated programmes, not only ITEP

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Pass Class 12. Admission is through NCET (National Common Entrance Test), run by NTA; NCTE requires ITEP institutions to admit only through NCET. Each participating institution then runs its own counselling.

value.title: At a glance
items: ITEP is offered at central and state universities, IITs, NITs, Regional Institutes of Education and government colleges.
You still need to clear CTET or a state TET for most teaching jobs.
The stage you train for shapes which classes you are prepared to teach.

value.title: Integrated B.Ed enrolment by year
value.note: Sum of B.A. B.Ed., B.Sc. B.Ed. and B.Com. B.Ed. rows; includes older integrated programmes
value.source: AISHE 2021-22 to 2023-24, all modes (Ministry of Education)
